results.title: Hardness Magnification for Natural Problems
results.statement: For natural problems including MCSP variants, sufficiently mild lower bounds in weak models can already imply strong consequences such as NP not in P/poly or strong formula lower bounds.
results.summary: The leading MCSP route is no longer novel at the level of magnification-as-such; the open step is the typed carrier or realization theorem that would instantiate the route inside the current proof state.
